stem.text: A box is shown resting on the ground. Newton's third law implies that four forces of equal magnitude are involved. These forces are labelled P, Q, R and S.
Forces P and Q act on the box. Forces R and S act on the Earth.
For clarity, the forces are shown slightly separated.

stem.alt: Force diagram of a box on a horizontal ground line. Printed labels: box, ground, P, Q, R, S.

stem.text: Which statement about the forces is correct?

A.text: P is the equal and opposite force to Q and both are forces of contact.

B.text: Q is the equal and opposite force to P and both are gravitational forces.

C.text: R is the equal and opposite force to S and both are forces of contact.

D.text: S is the equal and opposite force to Q and both are gravitational forces.
